description: Cross-Run Analytics components — CrossRunPatternsPanel, StepProvenanceTimeline, SelectorDecayChart, and FailureChainViewer. Used within the Reflection Dashboard and element detail views. CrossRunPatternsPanel shows recurring_finding and fix_oscillation patterns from the knowledge graph's cross_run_patterns table. StepProvenanceTimeline shows which pipeline agent generated each step with UI Bridge interaction overlays. SelectorDecayChart tracks element reliability over time. FailureChainViewer traces graph paths from UI elements through task runs to workflows, findings, and fixes.

groups.name: Cross-Run Pattern Elements
groups.description: The CrossRunPatternsPanel renders a list of detected patterns with type badges, signature hashes, occurrence counts, timestamps, and status indicators. Each pattern row has a type badge (recurring_finding or fix_oscillation), truncated signature hash, occurrence count, last seen date, and status badge.

assertions.description: The cross-run patterns panel is identifiable by its AlertTriangle icon heading
When no patterns exist, an empty state message is shown

groups.name: Pattern Data Display
groups.description: Each pattern row shows: type badge (yellow 'Recurring Finding' with TrendingUp icon, or orange 'Fix Oscillation' with RefreshCw icon), signature_hash first 12 chars in monospace, affected_components below in muted text, occurrence count as bold 'Nx', last seen date, and status badge (active=red, resolved=green, suppressed=gray). Data from GET /graph/cross-run-patterns.

assertions.description: Pattern types are distinguished visually: recurring findings have yellow badges with TrendingUp, fix oscillations have orange badges with RefreshCw
assertions.precondition: At least one cross-run pattern exists in cross_run_patterns table

assertions.description: Each pattern shows its occurrence count as a bold number with 'x' suffix (e.g., '5x')

groups.name: Pattern Status Semantics
groups.description: Pattern status badges communicate urgency through color: 'active' (red bg-red-500/10) means the pattern is still occurring and needs attention, 'resolved' (green bg-green-500/10) means a fix successfully addressed it, 'suppressed' (gray bg-muted) means it was intentionally ignored. These match the cross_run_patterns.status column values.

assertions.description: Active patterns use red styling to signal they need immediate attention
assertions.precondition: At least one active pattern exists

assertions.description: Resolved patterns use green styling to confirm the fix worked

groups.name: Step Provenance Timeline Elements
groups.description: Vertical timeline with colored dots per agent. Each step shows: agent-colored dot (3x3px rounded), step name, phase badge (setup/verification/agentic/completion in bg-muted), step index (#N), generating agent name in monospace, generation iteration, and UI Bridge interaction count badge. Legend at bottom shows all 5 agent colors. Max height 384px with scroll.

assertions.description: The provenance timeline has a GitBranch icon heading
When no provenance data exists, an empty state is shown

groups.name: Provenance Agent Color Coding
groups.description: Each step's timeline dot color identifies the generating agent: discovery (blue bg-blue-500), builder (green bg-green-500), fixer (orange bg-orange-500), hardener (purple bg-purple-500), verifier (cyan bg-cyan-500), other (gray bg-muted-foreground). The legend at bottom shows all agent colors. Steps with UI Bridge interactions show a count badge (e.g., '3 UI interactions' in bg-primary/10 text-primary).

assertions.description: The legend shows color-coded agent names: discovery, builder, fixer, hardener, verifier

target.label: Agent color legend with all 5 types

assertions.precondition: A workflow is selected and has step_provenance records

assertions.description: Steps that involved UI Bridge element interactions show a count badge (parsed from step_provenance.ui_bridge_event_ids JSON)
assertions.precondition: A step has non-null ui_bridge_event_ids in step_provenance

groups.name: Provenance Loading and Error States
groups.description: The timeline shows 'Loading provenance...' during fetch, an error message in text-destructive on failure, and the agent legend only when data is available.

assertions.description: During data fetch, a loading message is displayed centered in the panel

groups.name: Selector Decay Chart Data Display
groups.description: Line chart showing success rate over time windows. X-axis: window labels (W1, W2, ..., newest last). Y-axis: 0-100% with dashed reference line at 95% (reliability threshold). Uses primary color stroke, width 2, dots enabled. A declining curve indicates the element's selector is degrading and needs CTR updates. Used in element detail views, not the main dashboard. Backed by GET /ui-bridge/analytics/decay-curve.

assertions.description: The chart shows 'Selector Decay:' followed by the element ID in monospace with TrendingDown icon

target.label: Decay chart heading with element ID

assertions.precondition: An element ID is provided and has interaction history in ui_bridge_events

groups.name: Decay Chart Reference Line Semantics
groups.description: The dashed line at 95% represents the reliability threshold. Elements above this line are considered reliable. Elements below need attention — their selectors may be breaking due to DOM restructuring, CSS changes, or app updates. The trend direction (rising vs falling) is more important than the absolute value.

assertions.description: A 95% reference line separates reliable (above) from unreliable (below) selector performance

groups.name: Failure Chain Viewer Elements
groups.description: Displays graph traversal paths as horizontal node chains. Each node has a colored dot (7 types: ui_element=blue, task_run=purple, workflow=green, finding=orange, fix=cyan, rule=yellow, error=red), kind label, and entity name (monospace). Nodes connected by ChevronRight arrows with edge kind labels. Multiple paths shown in separate bordered cards. Legend shows all node types. Max height 384px with scroll.

assertions.description: The viewer shows 'Failure Chain:' followed by the element ID with GitMerge icon

target.label: Failure chain heading with element ID

assertions.description: When no causal chains exist, an informative empty state is shown

groups.name: Failure Chain Node Type Semantics
groups.description: The graph traversal follows the knowledge graph: UIElement ← InteractedWith ← TaskRun → BelongsTo → Workflow, with DetectedDuring edges connecting to findings. Each node type's color communicates its role in the causal chain: blue elements are UI targets, purple runs are execution instances, green workflows are the automation definition, orange findings are discovered issues, cyan fixes are attempted solutions. This lets users trace 'why did this element fail?' back to its root cause.

assertions.description: The legend shows 7 node types with consistent colors matching the knowledge graph schema

target.label: Node type legend with all 7 types

assertions.precondition: At least one failure chain path was found for the given element

assertions.description: Paths read left-to-right with arrows showing the direction of causal relationship — the leftmost node is the failed UI element, rightmost is the connected workflow, finding, or fix

groups.name: Cross-Run Data Update Behavior
groups.description: CrossRunPatternsPanel accepts an optional workflowName prop to filter patterns. When no workflow is selected, all patterns are shown. The panel uses useCrossRunPatterns() hook with 30s stale time and 60s refetch interval. StepProvenanceTimeline requires a workflowId prop and is disabled when empty. SelectorDecayChart requires an elementId prop. FailureChainViewer requires an elementId prop.

assertions.description: When a workflowName is provided, the patterns panel shows only patterns related to that workflow; when none is provided, all patterns are shown
assertions.expected: Providing a workflowName prop should filter the displayed patterns to only those matching that workflow. Removing the filter should show all patterns.
assertions.precondition: Multiple patterns exist, some associated with different workflows

assertions.description: Pattern data automatically refreshes every 60 seconds without user action

states.name: Loading State
states.description: Initial loading state while fetching cross-run patterns and step provenance data from the backend. Loading indicators are visible and no pattern rows or timeline content are rendered yet.

transitions.name: Load completes with no patterns
transitions.description: Fetched data returns no cross-run patterns, showing the empty state message

transitions.name: Load completes with pattern data
transitions.description: Fetched data returns cross-run patterns, showing pattern rows with type badges, occurrence counts, and status indicators

states.name: Empty State — No Patterns
states.description: No cross-run patterns exist. The empty state message is displayed. The provenance timeline and element-detail panels are not visible because no workflow or element context is available.

transitions.name: Auto-refresh triggers reload
transitions.description: The 60-second auto-refresh interval fires and re-fetches pattern data, returning to the loading state

states.name: Patterns Loaded — Pattern List View
states.description: Cross-run pattern rows are displayed with type badges (Recurring Finding or Fix Oscillation), signature hashes, occurrence counts, last seen dates, and status badges (active/resolved/suppressed). The patterns panel heading with AlertTriangle icon is visible.

transitions.name: Workflow selected shows provenance
transitions.description: A workflowId is provided or a workflow is selected, causing the StepProvenanceTimeline to load and display

transitions.name: Element selected shows decay and chain
transitions.description: An elementId is provided, causing the SelectorDecayChart and FailureChainViewer to load for that element

states.name: Provenance Timeline Visible
states.description: The StepProvenanceTimeline is rendered with agent-colored dots, step names, phase badges, agent names, and the 5-agent color legend. The patterns panel remains visible alongside. UI Bridge interaction count badges appear on steps that have non-null ui_bridge_event_ids.

transitions.name: Workflow with no provenance data
transitions.description: The selected workflow has no step_provenance records, so the empty state is shown instead of the timeline

states.name: Provenance Empty State
states.description: The StepProvenanceTimeline is rendered but shows an empty state message because the selected workflow has no step_provenance records.

transitions.name: Different workflow selected with data
transitions.description: A different workflow is selected that has step_provenance records, populating the timeline

states.name: Element Detail — Decay Chart and Failure Chain
states.description: An element is selected, showing the SelectorDecayChart with its line chart (success rate over time windows, 95% reference line) and the FailureChainViewer with graph traversal paths displayed as horizontal node chains. The decay chart heading shows 'Selector Decay:' followed by the element ID. The failure chain heading shows 'Failure Chain:' followed by the element ID.

transitions.name: Element has no failure chains
transitions.description: The selected element has no causal chain paths in the knowledge graph, showing the empty failure chain state

transitions.name: Deselect element returns to patterns view
transitions.description: The element context is removed, hiding the decay chart and failure chain viewer and returning to the patterns-only view

states.name: Failure Chain Empty State
states.description: The FailureChainViewer is rendered but shows an empty state because no causal chain paths exist for the selected element in the knowledge graph. The SelectorDecayChart may still be visible with decay data.

transitions.name: Different element selected with chain data
transitions.description: A different element is selected that has failure chain paths, restoring the full element detail view
